tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, solid chips on marketing surfaces, brand panels, selected-state borders. Light: Gestalt Matchacado green 500 (white text on it is about 4.6:1, so keep text on brand bold or 16px and up). Dark: Matchacado 300, DERIVED by the same rule the old product used (light brand to a lighter shade for dark mode); confirm.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of the brand fill. Light: Matchacado 600. Dark: Matchacado 200 (derived).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover. Dark value is the old product's brand-on-color.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a SELECTED filter chip and of a drag-over target, always with a 2px brand border. A functional state colour, not a decorative panel. Light: Matchacado 50. Dark: Matchacado 800. Both derived from the old product's wash-blue role.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: Matchacado 0, a very light green. Dark: the old product's page colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Header, footer, cards, text fields, popovers. Dark value is the old product's card colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, links, text on grey fills.

tokens.name: text-neutral
tokens.usage: Secondary paragraphs and lead text. About 8.9:1 on surface in light. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, meta lines such as 'Added today'. About 6:1 on surface in light. Never on brand.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only; disabled controls are exempt from contrast rules. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: border-decorative
tokens.usage: Card borders, header and footer rules, disabled field borders. Dark is the old product's container border.

tokens.name: border-interactive
tokens.usage: Text field border. 3:1 or better on its ground. Dark is the old product's default border.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary (gray) button, neutral badges and chips, the unselected filter chip, the Ended lane ground, disabled fills. Dark is the old product's secondary base.

tokens.name: fill-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the secondary button, the inverse button and unselected chips. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Outer focus colour, drawn with a 2px inner ring in the page ground colour and 2px of this. Gestalt's focus blue is kept in light mode because it is a functional accessibility colour; dark is the old product's focus colour.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Carried from the old system. The 'Needs your input' signal only: the owner-action chip and the needs-input SectionCard. Nothing else is violet.

tokens.name: violet-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'Needs your input' chip and card, with a violet border. Carried from the old system.

tokens.name: warning-weak
tokens.usage: Ground of the warning closed-posting chip ('Closed N days ago'). Carried from the old system.

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon. Carried from the old system.

tokens.name: error-weak
tokens.usage: Ground of error banners. Carried from the old system. Red is never a brand colour.

tokens.name: text-error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon. Carried from the old system. Also the fill of the destructive confirm button in a delete dialog (surface text on it). Red appears nowhere else as a fill.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of the destructive confirm button (fill text-error). Both values DERIVED; confirm contrast.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Page title on the landing page (one h1).

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Section titles and the app page title (h1 inside the app, h2 on the landing page).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph on the landing page.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Default paragraph text. Job title on cards at weight 700.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, helper text, footer links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints such as 'Drop a job here to end it'.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label inside a text field, status select text, chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding, gaps between buttons and fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside cards, board card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, minimum mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and SectionCard padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on the landing page.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Top of the landing hero, bottom of the closing banner.

tokens.name: radius-100
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-200
tokens.usage: Carried from the old system: the status select.

tokens.name: radius-400
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, cards, the Ended lane.

tokens.name: radius-600
tokens.usage: Large panels: the hero board panel and the closing banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Carried from the old system: filter chips and quiet chips.
